name: Tile format
notes: MSX SCREEN2 3 pattern banks; Zanac loads the same 256 tiles into all 3.

name: Unique BG tiles
md_suggested: MAY 512-1024 user tiles (safe). Hardware ~TILE_SPACE/32 ≈ 1536 before maps (SGDK maps_addr).
notes: charset_tiles.bin 8192 B = 256×32. TILE_USER_INDEX=16, FONT_LEN=96, BG_TILE_BASE=TILE_USER_INDEX+32. Sprite engine eats tiles from the top.

name: On-screen colors
notes: Port now: PAL0 text, PAL1 highlight/objs, PAL2 ship, PAL3 TMS charset (map_script.c s_tms_pal).

name: Sprite hardware
notes: SGDK SPRITE w h in tiles. Sprite color 0 = transparent. Fold MSX complements into one sprite.

name: Unique sprite patterns
md_suggested: As many frames as VRAM sprite tiles allow (budget ~200-400 sprite tiles)

name: Per-scanline budget
notes: MSX complement sprites burn the 4/line cap. MD folding frees line budget.

name: Simultaneous objects
md_suggested: Port: 4 shot + 24 enemy + 1 ship sprites (software). HW max 80.
notes: Slots 0-4 player/shots/fire; 5-25 enemies. Type 39 complement/col-marker included.

name: Audio
md_suggested: YM2612 6 FM (ch6=DAC) + SN76489 3 square + noise. Original = PSG interpreter of the 27 MSX events (Z80_DRIVER_NULL).
notes: Zanac MD MAY use SGDK XGM (4 PCM @14 kHz) or XGM2 (3 PCM @13.3/6.65 kHz) or WAV PCM. Cannot mix XGM driver with the current NULL+PSG interpreter on the same Z80.

name: Safe Zanac MD art budget
md_suggested: BG 512-1024 tiles, 2-3 palettes; sprites 2x2 default (3x3/4x4 for large); 1 pal player, 1 pal enemies, 1 pal BG, PAL0 font
palette: PAL0 font, PAL1 player/items, PAL2 enemies, PAL3 BG
notes: Stay under ~1500 total VRAM tiles including font+sprites. 1024 BG + 300 sprite + 96 font is the ceiling to test, not the opening bid. Start at 512 BG.
